parsed.post: Discarding the 0.9808 result as it regressed from my best 0.9695. It seems the combination of depth-10 and AR=64 is sensitive to the other hyperparameters. Reverting to my best config and will now test reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if it stabilizes training for this capacity.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.04 on the best configuration (DEPTH=10, ASPECT_RATIO=64, WD=0.1, WARMUP=0.1, BATCH=262144) to improve convergence stability.
